name: chiptunes
description: Create or listen to complete Game Boy songs, composed automatically in your browser.
author: Shokunin

scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:site && npm run deploy:box
scripts.deploy:site: node build.js && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name retro-rave-radio --branch main --commit-dirty=true && node scripts/purge-cache.mjs
scripts.youtube:golive: YT_BOUNCE_CMD="ssh -o BatchMode=yes $CHIPTUNES_BOX \"sudo systemctl restart chiptunes-youtube\"" node broadcast/youtube-live.mjs start
scripts.test: node build.js && node scripts/verify-automation.js && node scripts/verify-rom.js && node scripts/verify-song-document.js && node scripts/verify-create-handover.js && node scripts/verify-frame-pacing.js && node scripts/verify-share.js && node scripts/verify-rhythm.js && node scripts/verify-ribbon.js && node scripts/verify-mood-constraints.js && node scripts/verify-export-boundaries.js && node scripts/verify-entry.js && node scripts/verify-radio-promotion.js && node scripts/verify-generated-transitions.js && node scripts/verify-sync.js && node scripts/verify-chrome.js && node scripts/verify-api.js && node scripts/verify-language.js && node scripts/verify-lsdj.js && node scripts/verify-lsdj-native.js && node scripts/verify-lsdj-trigger-state.js && node scripts/verify-lsdj-command-versions.js && node scripts/verify-lsdj-emulator.js && node scripts/verify-webmcp.js && node scripts/verify-diversity.js && node scripts/verify-latency.js && node scripts/verify-screens.js && node scripts/smoke-generated-seeds.js && node scripts/smoke-games.js && node scripts/audit-music-driven.js
scripts.test:lsdj: node scripts/verify-lsdj.js && node scripts/verify-lsdj-native.js && node scripts/verify-lsdj-trigger-state.js && node scripts/verify-lsdj-command-versions.js && node scripts/verify-lsdj-emulator.js
